title: redirect gate misses a redirect with no separator before it
detail: gate._REDIRECT_RE needs whitespace, an operator char or a quote before the redirect operator, so real writes such as cat> f1, echo a>f1, esac> f1 and $((1>2))> f1 return no target. Confirmed in real bash while fuzzing quote-aware-redirects (v0.235.1); it predates that change. A file HEAD appeared to catch here was only matched inside a comment. Separately, a target with escaped spaces (a\ b) is cut at the first space. Now that literal text is masked, the separator requirement may be droppable. Left out of that sprint.
